identity.life_stage: married, three children, HVAC technician; runs a food pantry

engagement.interaction_backstory: He opens a church fellowship hall twice a month for a food pantry that serves two hundred families, and he plays music over it because a silent room makes people feel like a case file. He is on the site maybe three times a month, and every time, two hundred people hear it.

depth.core_contradiction: Feeds two hundred families a month and has never once let his own family accept help.
depth.wound: They were the family in that line in 2011 and he remembers exactly how it felt to be looked at.
depth.longing: For one person in that line to leave feeling like a guest.
depth.faith_journey: Free Will Baptist by marriage, not by conviction; he is not sure he believes it and he is certain about the pantry.
depth.voice_fingerprint: One-word answers; fixes something while you talk to him.
depth.open_doubt: Whether doing the work counts if the belief underneath is thin.

social_graph.note: the one who prays; he lets her do it for both of them
a retired teacher who shows up before he does every time

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat and dependable; irritable in the two weeks before Christmas.
depth.daily_texture: Service calls in the heat, crawlspaces, the pantry van, Saturday inventory.
depth.sensory_anchor: The sound of a grocery bag handle, and being eleven.
depth.living_arc: The pantry is outgrowing him and he will not ask for help.
